verdict.rationale: Pricing and REST API docs confirm library publishing across teams/departments (figma-docs-12, figma-docs-37) and library analytics tracking component instance usage across files (figma-docs-55), supporting cross-file/project component distribution, but there is no explicit documentation in this pack of the update-propagation/notification mechanism when a source library changes (e.g., 'update available' prompts, accept/reject updates). Missing for 10: direct docs on library update notifications/controlled sync workflow, and independent corroboration of the update-control experience.
